services.name: Sip and Putt Mini Golf Scramble
services.desc: Sip, Sample & Putt your way through the RailPark for our 7th Annual Sip & Putt Mini Golf Scramble! Get your 4 person teams together and join us in our grand lobby where you will enjoy food and libations. Each team will have a table along with score cards, putters, and balls. Teams will play a 18+ hole challenge. Every dollar you contribute - through tickets, sponsorships, and memberships - supports our efforts to continue the preservation of the Historic RailPark.
